The cross-sectional area of the core 5000 \( mm^2 \) and the average core length traversed by the mutual flux is 500 mm. The maximum allowable flux density in the core is \( B_{max} = 1 \) Wb/\(m^2\) and the relative permeability of the core material is 5000. The leakage impedance of the winding \( a - b \) and winding \( c - d \) at 50 Hz are \( (5 + j100\pi \times 0.16)\Omega \) and \( (11.5 + j100\pi \times 0.36)\Omega \), respectively. Considering the magnetizing characteristics to be linear and neglecting core loss, the self-inductance of the winding \( a - b \) in millihenry is ___ (Round off to 1 decimal place).

图像描述：图中是单相双绕组变压器，左侧绕组端子为 a-b，标注开路端电压 V_ab = 200 V、50 Hz；右侧绕组端子为 c-d，由 50 Hz 交流电流源供电。

按指定方法计算：
1. 铁心截面积 A = 5000 mm^2 = 5000 × 10^-6 m^2 = 0.005 m^2。最大磁通密度 B_max = 1 Wb/m^2，所以最大磁通 Phi_max = B_max A = 1 × 0.005 = 0.005 Wb。

3. 由线性磁化特性，H = B / (mu0 mu_r)，其中 mu0 = 4π × 10^-7 H/m，mu_r = 5000。因此 H = 1 / (4π × 10^-7 × 5000) = 159.155 A/m。
4. 平均磁路长度 l = 500 mm = 0.5 m。a-b 绕组的励磁电流 I_m = H l / N_ab = 159.155 × 0.5 / 181 = 0.43965 A。
5. 磁链 lambda = N_ab Phi_max = 181 × 0.005 = 0.905 Wb-turn。励磁电感 L_m = lambda / I_m = 0.905 / 0.43965 = 2.0584 H。
6. a-b 绕组泄漏阻抗为 (5 + j100π × 0.16) Ω，50 Hz 时 omega = 100π rad/s，因此泄漏电感 L_leak = 0.16 H。
7. a-b 绕组自感 L_self = L_m + L_leak = 2.0584 + 0.16 = 2.2184 H = 2218.4 mH。

四舍五入到 1 位小数为 2218.4 mH。

planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text for the numerical constants: 50 Hz, 200 V rms, A = 5000 mm^2, l = 500 mm, B_max = 1 Wb/m^2, mu_r = 5000, and the a-b leakage impedance. The supplied c-d current-source condition is used only to justify that the observed a-b voltage is induced by mutual flux.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use Faraday’s law in rms transformer form to determine the integer number of a-b turns from the allowable peak flux. Then use B-H relations and Ampere’s law: H = B/(mu0 mu_r), mmf = H l = N I, so the current that would establish B_max when exciting a-b is I = H l/N. The magnetizing inductance follows from L_m = lambda/I = N Phi/I. Equivalently, magnetic energy density may be used. Finally add the given leakage inductance 0.16 H because self-inductance includes leakage plus mutual/core flux contribution.

3. 由线性磁化特性，H = B / (mu0 mu_r)，其中 mu0 = 4π × 10^-7 H/m，mu_r = 5000。因此 H = 1 / (4π × 10^-7 × 5000) = 159.155 A/m。
4. 平均磁路长度 l = 500 mm = 0.5 m。a-b 绕组的励磁电流 I_m = H l / N_ab = 159.155 × 0.5 / 181 = 0.43965 A。
5. 磁链 lambda = N_ab Phi_max = 181 × 0.005 = 0.905 Wb-turn。励磁电感 L_m = lambda / I_m = 0.905 / 0.43965 = 2.0584 H。
6. a-b 绕组泄漏阻抗为 (5 + j100π × 0.16) Ω，50 Hz 时 omega = 100π rad/s，因此泄漏电感 L_leak = 0.16 H。
7. a-b 绕组自感 L_self = L_m + L_leak = 2.0584 + 0.16 = 2.2184 H = 2218.4 mH。

四舍五入到 1 位小数为 2218.4 mH。

raw_record.original_question: When the winding \( c - d \) of the single-phase, 50 Hz, two winding transformer is supplied from an AC current source of frequency 50 Hz, the rated voltage of 200 V (rms), 50 Hz is obtained at the open-circuited terminals a-b. The cross-sectional area of the core is 5000 \( mm^2 \) and the average core length traversed by the mutual flux is 500 mm. The maximum allowable flux density in the core is \( B_{max} = 1 \) Wb/\(m^2\) and the relative permeability of the core material is 5000. The leakage impedance of the winding \( a - b \) and winding \( c - d \) at 50 Hz are \( (5 + j100\pi \times 0.16)\Omega \) and \( (11.5 + j100\pi \times 0.36)\Omega \), respectively. Considering the magnetizing characteristics to be linear and neglecting core loss, what is the self-inductance of the winding \( a - b \) in millihenry? (Round off to 1 decimal place).

Reasoning: According to the specified method, first determine the number of turns of the a-b winding from the rated open-circuit terminal voltage of a-b. The iron core cross-sectional area A = 5000 mm^2 = 0.005 m^2, the average magnetic path length l = 500 mm = 0.5 m, and the maximum magnetic flux density B_max = 1 Wb/m^2, so the maximum magnetic flux Phi_max = B_max A = 1 × 0.005 = 0.005 Wb. To ensure that the magnetic flux density does not exceed the maximum value, take the integer number of turns N_ab = 181. The iron core reluctance R_m = l / (mu0 mu_r A), where mu0 = 4π × 10^-7 H/m, mu_r = 5000, so R_m = 0.5 / [(4π × 10^-7) × 5000 × 0.005] = 15915.5 A/Wb. The magnetizing inductance of the a-b winding L_m = N_ab^2 / R_m = 181^2 / 15915.5 = 2.0584 H. The leakage reactance of the a-b winding is given as j100π × 0.16 Ω; at 50 Hz, omega = 100π rad/s, so the leakage inductance L_leak = 0.16 H. The self-inductance equals the magnetizing inductance plus the leakage inductance: L_self = 2.0584 + 0.16 = 2.2184 H = 2218.4 mH. Rounded to 1 decimal place, it is 2218.4 mH.
